caption: Merano Kurhaus and Passerpromenade, Merano
composition: Domed Kurhaus and palm-lined Passerpromenade beneath South Tyrolean peaks · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the opposite bank of the Passer, facing the Kurhaus and its riverside promenade in the bright 12:06 midday sun. The domed white Kurhaus rises at center-right above its arched loggia, palm trees line the Passerpromenade walk at the lower edge, and the pastel facades of Merano stretch left along the riverbank. The great rocky peaks of South Tyrol tower behind under a clear blue sky, the river glittering in the foreground.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Merano under midday light
